course_name_original: Digitaler Zwilling in Entwicklung und Konstruktion
course_name_en: Digital Twin in Development and Design
prerequisites: Knowledge from previous construction courses is required.

learning_outcomes.text: Students know all fundamental techniques of computer-aided design and supplement these with further digital model components/features in the design and development process.
Students are able to parameterize complex assemblies and derive variants. They have basic knowledge of integrating virtual methods for extended product design, simulation, and documentation.
Students can evaluate requirements for digital models based on their current practical expertise and create appropriate digital product models.
Students can perform further digital simulations and analyses based on the CAD modeling of products.
Students develop digital product models and test their functionality on the "digital twin".
Students communicate and cooperate within (student) development teams and with potential product users to develop the digital twin according to requirements.
Students can reflect on and appropriately apply the use of virtual twins in product development and design.

syllabus_topics: Decision aids for technically and economically sensible use of virtual twins
Overview of data acquisition for models
assessment_rules: The graded examination is a term paper. During the term paper, a virtual twin is created, and appropriate features are applied and documented according to its functions.
